links.scope: Development qualification, not held-out reliability or comparative superiority.
links.transport_correction: Private temporary CODEX_HOME avoids desktop database writes under RLIMIT_FSIZE. Same model, tasks, seeds and per-trial limits. Follow-up is a development transport qualification, not a fresh held-out panel.

question: Can the bounded native campaign execute supplied-input analysis, synthesis and finite mathematics and independently grade its outputs?

claims.text: Each submitted answer is checked exactly against an evaluator-held reference on the registered supplied-input instances.

arms.description: single orchestration with bounded native sessions
reviewed orchestration with bounded native sessions

aa.not_applicable_reason: Integration qualification makes no superiority claim; no noise-floor claim.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Separate software-control campaigns exercise independent exact answers through the same stage, grader and report path before inference.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Separate negative software-control campaign submits fabricated answers with success claims through the same grading path; those controls are not model evidence.

factors.name: model
factors.how: same explicit CLI model and effort for every stage; service revision not pinned

factors.name: inputs
factors.how: matched generated inputs independent of arm

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: deterministic random permutation per instance and repeat

factors.name: sessions
factors.how: single consumes one; reviewed consumes four under same per-trial ceiling; resources are not equalized

factors.name: host_service
factors.how: CLI version, traces and wall durations recorded; remote provider state uncontrolled

comparisons.threshold: Each final answer must exactly match the evaluator-held reference.

seed_derivation.note: First 16 hex digits of SHA256(f"20261107:dev:{task_id}:{instance}"); arm permutation Random(seed+repeat). Public generator, references withheld from actors.

instance_sampling.rule: One independently seeded instance of each of three named families at difficulty 1. This is a development smoke panel.

blinding.how: Descriptive qualification only; exact graders do not use arm identity.

power.note: One instance per family is insufficient for a reliability claim. No decisive comparative test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative timeout envelope: 6 trials times 120 seconds. This is a bound, not a timing measurement.

primary.name: Exact verified answer
primary.definition: One iff final output passes evaluator-held deterministic reference and all stages completed

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly 6 trials, at most 15 fresh native sessions, concurrency 1, no automatic campaign retry; per trial 120 seconds, local actor 4096 MiB address space and one allowed CPU. Existing ChatGPT subscription, dollar billing unavailable; no cloud compute submitted. One corrective qualification attempt after the original failed transport attempt; combined ceiling 30 sessions across both attempts, no further automatic retries.

invalidation_rules: All failures stay in denominators; tool use invalidates a trial.
Missing usage and billing are null, never zero.
A completed process or reviewer approval alone cannot verify an answer.

decision_rule.text: Report exact answer verification on each development case. Never promote reliability from this development panel.
decision_rule.statistic: verified count by family and arm
decision_rule.interval: Descriptive 95% Wilson intervals clustered by instance; small-sample uncertainty only.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: descriptive paired wins and losses only

graphs: Verified / attempted trials by family and arm; descriptive counts

inadmissible: Claiming any-domain reliability from this supplied-input development panel
Treating software controls as live model successes
Claiming matched token spend or known dollar cost
Changing seeds or sample counts after seeing outputs

literature.claim: Evaluate model and scaffold together and verify outcome separately from transcript.
Native structured output and event-stream interface; actual CLI help checked on host.
Legacy evaluator measures narrower executor behavior; new bounded campaign explicitly measures stages.

amendments.reason: Original native qualification hit SIGXFSZ before producing answers; desktop databases exceed the actor file-size ceiling. Preserve the original attempt and qualify the corrected isolated transport.
changes: Use a private temporary CODEX_HOME with only file-backed saved login.
Allow one corrective six-trial panel; at most 30 sessions combined across the two attempts.
